params.body:
The hover readout on the series works — it says the day and the number — but it hangs from the **top** of the bar, so a bar at full height throws it above the groove and onto the card's own header. On a 135-bar it covered "hoogste 135": the readout was hiding the very number it was reporting against.

The fix is room rather than repositioning. 26px above the plot, which is the readout's height plus its gap, so a full-height bar's readout lands in empty space.

The grid gets the same, for the same reason: the top row is Monday, and its readout was going over that card's header too.

The horizontal case was already handled — the last three bars anchor their readout to the right so it cannot fall off the card.

## Verified

`test_the_readout_has_room_above_the_bars` pins both values. It is a test and not just a comment because nothing else fails when this padding goes: the readout still appears, it just lands on text, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than as a missing rule.

CSS only, no markup, no rule change. `npm run build` green (lightningcss parses it), `StylesheetSyntaxTest` green.
params.title: The readout needs room above the bars
